nodes.title: Settings Info
widgets_values:
Tested with Flux fp16 and fp8.

Use round Image to avoid the error about [mixed models](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues/5098)

Additional Loras can be used, including [Hyper Flux 8 step Lora](https://civitai.com/models/848960/hyper-flux-8-step-lora)

nodes.title: Prompting
widgets_values:
## Gemini System Prompt  
At the bottom of the you can add a short general prompt that you want Gemini to focus on, besides the input image.  

## L Prompt  
This can be treated as a normal SDXL prompt, more or less.

## Detailer Prompt  
Prompt that is specifically for the face.
